text: הש״ץ לוחש אתה זוכר.

אַתָּה זוֹכֵר מַעֲשֵׂה עוֹלָם וּפוֹקֵד כָּל־יְצוּרֵי קֶדֶם. לְפָנֶיךָ נִגְלוּ כָּל־תַּעֲלוּמוֹת וַהֲמוֹן נִסְתָּרוֹת שֶׁמִּבְּרֵאשִׁית. כִּי אֵין שִׁכְחָה לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶךָ. וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּגֶד עֵינֶיךָ: אַתָּה זוֹכֵר אֶת כָּל־הַמִּפְעָל. וְגַם כָּל־הַיְצוּר לֹא נִכְחַד מִמֶּךָּ. הַכֹּל גָּלוּי וְיָדוּעַ לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ. צוֹפֶה וּמַבִּיט עַד סוֹף כָּל־הַדּוֹרוֹת. כִּי תָבִיא חֹק זִכָּרוֹן לְהִפָּקֵד כָּל רוּחַ וָנֶפֶשׁ. לְהִזָּכֵר מַעֲשִׂים רַבִּים וַהֲמוֹן בְּרִיּוֹת לְאֵין תַּכְלִית. מֵרֵאשִׁית כָּזֹאת הוֹדָעְתָּ. וּמִלְּפָנִים אוֹתָהּ גִּלִּיתָ. זֶה הַיּוֹם תְּחִלַּת מַעֲשֶׂיךָ זִכָּרוֹן לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן. כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב: וְעַל הַמְּדִינוֹת בּוֹ יֵאָמֵר אֵיזוֹ לַחֶרֶב. וְאֵיזוֹ לְשָׁלוֹם. אֵיזוֹ לָרָעָב. וְאֵיזוֹ לָשֹׂבַע. וּבְרִיּוֹת בּוֹ יִפָּקֵדוּ. לְהַזְכִּירָם לְחַיִּים וְלַמָּוֶת: מִי לֹא נִפְקַד כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה. כִּי זֵכֶר כָּל הַיְצוּר לְפָנֶיךָ בָּא. מַעֲשֵׂה אִישׁ וּפְקֻדָּתוֹ. וַעֲלִילוֹת מִצְעֲדֵי גָבֶר. מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם וְתַחְבּוּלוֹתָיו וְיִצְרֵי מַעַלְלֵי־אִישׁ: אַשְׁרֵי אִישׁ שֶׁלֹּא יִשְׁכָּחֶךָּ. וּבֶן אָדָם יִתְאַמֶּץ־בָּךְ. כִּי דוֹרְשֶׁיךָ לְעוֹלָם לֹא יִכָּשֵׁלוּ. וְלֹא יִכָּלְמוּ לָנֶצַח כָּל־הַחוֹסִים בָּךְ: כִּי זֵכֶר כָּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים לְפָנֶיךָ בָּא. וְאַתָּה דוֹרֵשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה כֻלָּם:

text: Thou rememberest the work of the world and Thou art aware of all creatures of antiquity. Before Thee all secrets are revealed and the multitude of hidden things from the beginning of time. There is no forgetfulness before Thy glorious throne and there is nought concealed before Thine eyes. Thou rememberest every deed and not even one creature is hidden from Thee. Everything is exposed and known before Thee, O Lord our God, watching and looking to the end of all generations. For Thou dost bring a fixed time for remembrance, when every spirit and soul will be considered and many deeds and an infinite mass of creatures will be remembered. From the beginning hast Thou made this known and long ago revealed it. This is the day of the beginning of Thy works, a memorial of the first day, for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob. And regarding territories, it is decided on it which shall be for the sword and which for peace, which for famine and which for plenty. And the creatures will be considered on it to be mentioned either for life or death. Who is not considered on this day? Indeed the memory of every created thing comes before Thee, man’s work and his task, the actions of man’s footsteps, man’s thought and his devices, and the motives of man’s deeds. Fortunate the man who does not forget Thee and the son of man who clings to Thee, for those that seek Thee will never stumble nor will those that take refuge with Thee ever be disgraced. For the remembrance of all actions comes before Thee and Thou dost examine all of them.
On Sabbath.

Noah also didst Thou remember in love and consider for the sake of salvation and compassion when Thou didst bring the waters of the flood to destroy all flesh because of the wickedness of their actions. Therefore his memory came before Thee, O Lord our God, to increase his descendants like the dust of the earth and his offspring like the sand of the sea.
מיוסד ע״פ תשר״ק מנענע לחך זכר.

text: זְכֹר תְּחִלַּת כָּל מַעַשׂ. אֲשֶׁר בְּכָל שָׁנָה נַעַשׂ. תּוֹהֲלִים לְמָאָשׂ. יוֹצֵר בַּל יִזְכֹּר: תּוֹלְדוֹת מַעַשׂ. אִם יָצְאָה בְכַעַשׂ. תּוֹמֵךְ לְמַעֲנוֹ יַעַשׂ. וִיצוּרִים יִזְכֹּר: שֶׁבְּרֵאשִׁית. תְּבוּאַת רֵאשִׁית. שֹׁרֶשׁ בִּכּוּר רֵאשִׁית. יֵרָא וְיִזְכֹּר: שֶׁצֶף חֲרִישַׁת. אִם חָר לְהָשִׁית. שְׁכִיחָה אֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁית. לְשׁוֹבְבִים יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר רֹאשׁ עֲפָרוֹת. וְתוֹלְדוֹת סְפוּרוֹת. רִשּׁוּם סְפָרוֹת. לְמִסְפַּר חוֹל יִזְכֹּר: רֶבַע מִסְפָּרוֹת. מְחַנְנֵי לְכַפָּרוֹת. רֶגֶשׁ שׁוֹפָרוֹת. לְשַׁפְּרָם יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר קְרִיאַת סֵפֶר. אֲשֶׁר גָּלְמִי שָׁפֶר. קָצַב לוֹ בַסֵּפֶר. בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר לִזְכֹּר: קֶצֶב אָם

מיוסד ע״פ א״ב כפול זולתי מחרוזות.

אֶפְחַד בְּמַעֲשַׂי. אֶדְאַג בְּכָל עֵת. אִירָא בְּיוֹם דִּין. בְּבוֹאִי לְזִכָּרוֹן: אֶדְרֹשׁ לְחָנוּן. אַחֲלֶה לְרַחוּם. אֶתְחַנֵּן לְחַק לִי יוֹם לְזִכָּרוֹן: בְּמָן לְבַד כִּי אֶשָּׁעֵן. וּמִי יְפַלֵּשׂ לִי צֶדֶק לְזִכָּרוֹן: בַּאֲבוֹת בָּטַחְתִּי. וּבְפָעֳלָם אֲכַלְתִּי. וְהֵם הָיוּ לִי קֶדֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן: גָּבְרָה זְרוֹעִי. כְּשָׂח מְחֵנִי נָא. לְבַל יִמַּח מִנִּי שֵׁם וְזִכָּרוֹן: גָּבַר אִם יַעֲמוֹד לְנֶגְדּוֹ וְיוֹעִיל. בְּעֵת יְבֻקַּשׁ מִנִּי זְכוּת לְזִכָּרוֹן: רָצִיתִי בִּלְבוּשׁ אֵפוֹד. וְחֹשֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּט. אֲשֶׁר שְׁמִי בָּם הֻחַק לְזִכָּרוֹן: שִׁמֵּר לְזִכָּרוֹן. דֶּלֶג בַּמַּחֲתָּה. עַד יֵעָצַר נֶגֶף. כְּגֶשֶׁת זָר מִבַּחוּץ יְלַהֵט לְזִכָּרוֹן: הִנְנִי מוּךְ אֵל בְּעָמְדִי לְפָנֶיךָ. אֵין בְּקִרְבִּי אֲנוֹשׁ. תּוּ לְזִכָּרוֹן. הֲיֵשׁ מִי יְפַלֵּל וְיָשִׁיב

text: On the day of memory of the beginning of all action, let the Creator not remember those of the deeds of the whole year that are in conflict with Israel’s hopes. If reproof for those deeds has gone forth in anger, may He grant help for His own sake and remember the creatures. May He look and recall the memory of the people He first appointed, the first harvest, the root of the first fruit. When in His anger He determines to send severe punishment, may He remember the atonement which He has ordained for the faithless. He remembers the first man who was formed from dust, the countless generations and the inscribed (good deeds) on behalf of the people that is like the sand in number. He remembers those counted in four camps who implore expiation and sound the Shofar in order to purify themselves. He remembers what was read out from the book that was bestowed by Him upon the first man even before its completion. He had decided in that book that He was to be remembered in every generation. I am anxious because of my deeds, I worry constantly, I fear on the day of judgment when I come for remembrance. I seek out the Merciful, I entreat the Compassionate, I implore Him who has appointed this day for me for remembrance. When I come in judgment, on whom shall I rely, who will find righteousness for me as a remembrance? Upon the fathers I put my trust, I derive benefit from their work, they have from of old served as my remembrance. My arm was strong when Moses pleaded to be wiped out, so that my name should not be wiped out nor should my remembrance. Should a man stand before the Lord, can he then help me, when merit is required from me for remembrance. I rejoiced with him (Aaron) who wore the Ephod and the Breast-plate of Judgment on which my name was engraved for remembrance. He hastened with his censor until the plague had abated, when a stranger (Korah) approached to act as priest, the flames devoured him as a remembrance. text: הֶחָרֵט בַּסֵּפֶר. לְבִלְתִּי מְצוֹא כֹפֶר. קִיּוּם זִכְרוֹן זֶה סֵפֶר. לְפָנָיו יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר צְפוּן מוֹרְדֵי אוֹר. תָּמִים דּוֹר כָּאוֹר. צִיָּה כְּחַת לָאוּר. קִנְיָן יִזְכֹּר: צְפוּפִים פְּנֵי נָאוֹר. מִשְׁפָּטָם תֵּת לָאוֹר. צַחַן רֹעַ שְׂאוֹר. בְּרִיב בַּל יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר פְּעֻלַּת אוֹרַח. הֶעִירוֹתָה מִמִּזְרָח. פָּעֳלוֹ יִזְרָח. בְּקֶרֶב שָׁנִים יִזְכֹּר: פַּח אִם הַמְרָח. פְּרַחֲיוֹ לְמָרַח. פִּלּוּלוֹ יִצְרַח. בְּעַדָם יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר עֲקֵדַת מוֹרִיָּה. כֵּהִית רְאִיָּה. עֲדֵי עֵרוֹם וְעֶרְיָה. סְבוּכוֹ יִזְכֹּר: עֲצַב מְרִירָה. אִם פוֹאֲבָה פוֹרִיָּה. עֲתָרוֹ לִרְאָיָה. וְלִזְכוּת יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר סֻלָּם חָלַם. וְעָלָיו מְחוֹלָלָם. שָׂרֵי אַרְבַּע וְעֻלָּם. בּוֹ כְּמֵאָז יִזְכֹּר: שְׁרוֹיוֹן בְּמַעֲלָם. וַיֹּאמֶר לְגָעֳלָם. שַׂחֲוּ

atonement can be found, then He remembers the confirmation of this book. He remembers the hidden one (Noah) in the age of open rebels, the perfect and the pure; when He is angry and wishes to curse the earth, He remembers those acquired by Him (Israel). As to those who stand crowded together before the countenance of the Awe-inspiring, may He bring to light their judgment; may He not in strife recall the ugly evil leaven. He remembers the work of that strong one whom He told to rise up from the east (Abraham). May He soon recall his shining act. When destruction threatens to annihilate his offspring, may his supplication become audible that He may remember them kindly. He remembers the sacrifice on Moriah (Isaac) whose eyes become dim; for the sake of people naked and bare, may He recall the ram caught in the thicket. When the fruitful people is afflicted with a festering wound, may his prayer be manifest that God may remember his merit. He remembers him who saw the ladder in the dream (Jacob); above it the Creator appeared to him, showed him the princes of the four empires and their yoke. He will remember him, as in former days. back anger (like Pinhas), then let his name be inscribed for future generations as a remembrance. Who is it that hates gain that he might say: “Testify against me”, and the Lord Himself replied as a witness for remembrance. With a sucking lamb he (Samuel) atoned for us and, equal to the noble pair of brothers (Moses and Aaron), he rises for remembrance. When he saw the wrath of the Lord, he (David) said: “Let Thy hand turn against me”, that he conformed to the will of his God is his remembrance. He cried out and caused the angel’s sword to return to its sheath, therefore was his throne established as firmly as the sun for remembrance. At the time of drought I wait for Him who releases and brings rain (Elijah), who restored breath to the child already lost to remembrance. He lives on as a witness at circumcisions because he spoke of his zeal when the people had abandoned both covenant and remembrance. Formerly I had one who could atone before the Lord, when he brought the meal-offering as a bribe for remembrance. Gifts of nard and spices perfumed His chambers, blood and fat as a delight and the show-bread for remembrance. I was placed like an empty vessel upon the coals, that Israel may not be widowed, I plead
